trailhead.label: Car park at the top of Monte Pana (official start)

cautions: Short stretches on the Monte Pana road at the start and end, open to cars.
Small grass-covered footbridges that can be hard to see (km 1.5–1.7).
Play and activity stations along the path.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
